data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for next season. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leave 50, and let the lake refill to 100. If we all stick to that, each of us can earn $10,000 a month without draining the lake. I propose a 10-ton limit each, with everyone reviewing the catches together afterward. John, would you agree to that?
